title: Read then Read/Write Multiple Registers sequence
target_operation: Read Holding Registers and Read/Write Multiple Registers
purpose: Increase state and parser diversity with a two-step sequence that first performs a simple documented register read and then exercises the combined read/write register transaction.
expected_behavior: Server first processes function 0x03 using the supplied starting address and quantity. It then processes function 0x17 as a combined transaction, reading one register from address 0x0000 and writing one register at address 0x0001 with byte count 0x02 and value 0x002A, returning the read portion if supported.
constraints_preserved: Each message uses a 7-byte MBAP header
Protocol identifier set to 0x0000 in both messages
First MBAP length 0x0006 matches unit id plus 5-byte PDU for function 0x03
Second MBAP length 0x000f matches unit id plus 14-byte PDU for function 0x17
Function 0x03 request includes Starting Address and Quantity of Registers as documented
Function 0x17 selected from documented function catalog and completed conservatively with internally consistent read/write counts and byte count
Canonical field ordering preserved across both requests
issue_safety_notes: Safe stateful coverage only. Combined-register request is structurally valid and avoids malformed count or byte-count mismatches.
